name: restoration_authority
query: Who can authorize restoring backups after a disaster?
padding: Warehouse status: shelf counts are unchanged. The inventory ledger lists brass bolts and plain cardboard boxes.
evidence: Only Morgan may sign off on recovering the archived copies following a catastrophic outage.
stale: Previously, Casey signed off on recovering archived copies. This instruction was superseded by Morgan.
decoys: Routine warehouse inventory is filed every Tuesday.
Fire drills take place in the west courtyard.
The cafeteria serves lunch at noon.
Meeting rooms close at six o'clock.
